description: Known answers from Puro Geologically Stored Carbon, Edition 2024 v. 5 (approved 23 April 2026). Clause numbers and wording from research_notes/Puro and Isometric supplier onboarding/puro_gsc_documents.md.

questions.question: How long is the crediting period for a geological storage project, and can it be renewed?
For how long must the injected CO2 stream be stored in the reservoir?
questions.note: The document states the 1,000-year requirement twice in the same words: 3.2.6 ("The CO₂ Stream shall be injected ... for at least 1000 years", the rule on the injected stream itself) and 3.2.1 (the definition of an eligible activity). Either citation answers the question.

questions.question: How is the number of CORCs calculated for a monitoring period?
questions.note: Before clause chunking (19 Nov 2026) search returned the section intro on p.29 instead of this clause; since rule passages it comes back first. Bedrock Data Automation keeps the equation ("CORCs = Cstored - Eproject - Eleakage - Ereversal").
